_doc: Bambu Lab TPU 95A, printed, for analysis: a rubber (Shore 95A) for hinges, folds and soft springs. Its stiffness and strength along the layers (x-y) and across them (z) are the maker's data sheet's, each with its own spread; its strain at break is several hundred percent. A rubber is far from linear: the modulus is its small-strain stiffness, and flex_strain is the strain a flexure in it is sized to, an estimate. Printed values vary with the printer, settings and spool: measure your own and record it as kind measured.
name: tpu

modulus.source: Bambu Lab TPU 95A technical data sheet V3.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040), as hosted by a reseller: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0645/5876/0155/files/Bambu_TPU_95A_Technical_Data_Sheet.pdf

modulus_z.source: Bambu Lab TPU 95A technical data sheet V3.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength.source: Bambu Lab TPU 95A technical data sheet V3.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength_z.source: Bambu Lab TPU 95A technical data sheet V3.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

elongation.rule: Strain at break along the layers (x-y), as a fraction: more than 700% (across the layers, more than 500%)
elongation.source: Bambu Lab TPU 95A technical data sheet V3.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040), breaking elongation rate

stress_100.rule: A second maker's 95A TPU: the stress at 100% strain along the layers, ± 0.7. Its curve bends over past it (19.9 MPa at 200%, 23.0 at 300%, 24.2 at 400%), so the rubber is far from linear there
stress_100.source: Polymaker PolyFlex TPU95-HF technical data sheet V5.5 (ISO 37, GB/T 528), https://polymaker.com/wp-content/uploads/TDS_Polymaker_PolyFlex-TPU95-HF_V5.5_2025-12-29_EN.pdf

flex_strain.rule: The strain a flexure in TPU is sized to, as a fraction (25%): an estimate. Neither data sheet gives a fatigue or set limit; this is a quarter of the 100% strain past which the second maker's curve bends over (stress_100), so a fold that stays under it bends where the rubber is still near its small-strain stiffness and springs back. Strength over modulus, 3.2, is no guide for a rubber. Measure your own fold's set after many cycles
flex_strain.source: An estimate from the two data sheets' curves (stress_100 above); no published fatigue limit found

poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio (Bambu publish none): an estimate for a rubber, which keeps its volume as it stretches (0.5 would be exactly so)
poisson.source: Not on either data sheet; a rubber's is near 0.5

density.rule: Density of Bambu Lab TPU 95A (the second maker's TPU95-HF: 1.16)
density.source: Bambu Lab TPU 95A technical data sheet V3.0 (ISO 1183)

overhang.rule: The steepest overhang the maker says TPU 95A prints at, about 70 degrees
overhang.source: Bambu Lab TPU 95A technical data sheet V3.0, recommended printing settings: max overhang angle about 70°
